Class SimulationContextImpl

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.simulation.SimulationContextImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationContext
public class SimulationContextImpl extends Object implements SimulationContext
Concrete implementation of SimulationContext. Provides safe, read-only access to simulation state for ant brains.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
